title: Late Issue of Summit Choice-Benefit Upgrade Certificates
content:
**Rule.** When a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program choice-benefit selection of upgrade certificates is issued late, the selection certificates are treated according to the delay, counted in calendar days from the selection's date to the day of the issue:

- more than 180 days: the selection certificates are multiplied by 1.5 and rounded up to the whole certificate;
- more than 30 and up to 180 days: 1 certificate is added to them;
- within 30 days: they are carried unchanged.

The selection certificates are the upgrade certificates per selection of the tier the member holds; the selection is the latest selection of upgrade certificates on the membership.

### Input, judgement, output (hypothetical)

| Selection certificates | Days from selection to issue | Certificates after this rule |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 181 | 6 |
| 6 | 181 | 9 |
| 8 | 200 | 12 |
| 6 | 180 | 7 |
| 6 | 31 | 7 |
| 6 | 30 | 6 |

Where the multiplication gives a fraction, it is rounded up; with a hypothetical 5 selection certificates, 7.5 becomes 8.
